notes.title: Exoborne's freak weather can help it break the extraction shooter curse
notes.content:
The extraction shooter boom has been more of a poot than an explosion as of late. Creative Assembly's Hyenas laughed its last in late 2023, while Ubisoft's The Division Heartlands had a stake driven through it last year. Upcoming efforts Marathon and ARC Raiders have avoided the chop so far, but the lack of games making it to market, alongside the failures of those like Rainbow Six Extraction, proves this isn't an easy genre to nail. This hasn't deterred Vampire the Masquerade Bloodhunt developer Sharkmob, which is baring its fangs with the post-apocalyptic Exoborne. Having delved into the latest playtest, the studio's vision could not be clearer, and it could just whip up a storm.

Read the rest of the story...

notes.title: Exoborne Playtest - Known Issues
notes.content:
Reborn! 

The Exoborne Playtest is almost upon us! The servers will be going live today (February 12) at 14:00 CET, available in North America, Europa and Asia.

Please keep in mind that Exoborne is still in development, which means that some aspects of the game are still unfinished. We are also working on performance optimization, so we ask you to keep this in mind as we continue to improve this over time.

[h3][b]Most impactful Issues and Workarounds[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Extraction Dropship Issues: [/b]Calling a dropship may sometimes fail, even though the interaction completes. Other players may still be able to call the dropship. The issue may resolve itself after some time or in a new session.
[*] [b]Potential GPU-related crash with the latest Nvidia drivers[/b]: Should you run into this issue we suggest doing a re-install of the drivers, or reverting to the previously released version.
[*] [b]The game may crash due to Intel CPU incompatibilities, or other hardware-related factors.[/b] If you have a 13th or 14th-gen Intel Core CPU, updating your BIOS may help: [url=https://www.theverge.com/2024/4/9/24125036/intel-game-crash-13900k-14900k-fortnite-unreal-engine-investigation]Intel investigating games crashing on 13th and 14th Gen Core i9 processors - The Verge[/url]
[*] [b]Performance Drops[/b]: FPS may drop below the target in some areas, particularly when waterfalls are in view, during loading screens, or when abilities are spammed.
[/list]
[h3][b]General & Social Issues[/b][/h3]
[b]Spawning Issues:[/b]
[list]
[*] In rare cases, players may spawn too close to bots or on top of a tornado during a storm sequence.
[*] Interaction Issues:
[*] All interaction prompts that require you to press and hold F may prevent activation if the F key is spammed. (Workaround: Wait a few seconds or go call an extraction.)
[*] Group deployment may fail if the leader deploys while a teammate is in another menu.
[/list]
[b]Audio Issues:[/b]
[list]
[*] Weapon reload and firing sounds may loop inside buildings.
[*] Spectator mode audio may cut off when watching teammates.
[*] Some EXO sprint sounds may end earlier than expected.
[*] Fire effects may be slightly desynced between SFX and VFX.
[*] Some footsteps may be too quiet or missing for enemies and NPCs.
[/list]
[b]Localization Issues:[/b]
[list]
[*] Some text is not yet translated and may appear in English or as placeholders.
[*] Enemy names may appear incorrectly in Objectives, Notifications, and Death Screen.
[*] Objective text in non-English languages may be broken or grammatically incorrect.
[/list]
[h3][b]Tech & Performance Issues[/b][/h3]
[b]Graphics & Performance Issues:[/b]
[list]
[*] FPS drops can occur in certain areas or when many players are in the same location.
[*] Low/Medium settings may cause LOD (Level of Detail) issues and flickering textures.
[*] Performance may degrade when resizing the game window on a secondary monitor.
[*] Net corrections (minor position adjustments) can occur when observing other players, especially during traversal actions.
[/list]
[b]Mouse & UI Issues:[/b]
[list]
[*] Mouse input may become offset when resizing the game resolution on a secondary monitor, making UI interactions difficult.
[*] Inventory and modification UI elements may appear misaligned at different resolutions.
[/list]
[b]Network Issues[/b]
[list]
[*] Error Code [PNG01] Unable to Determine Region
[*] Workaround: If you get this, right-click on Exoborne in Steam, and click on Properties. Then add '-[*] SgForceIpv4' into Launch Options. This should get around this.
[/list]
[b]Loading Issues:[/b]
[list]
[*] Players may experience FPS drops during loading screens.
[*] Game restart may be required in certain cases to fix UI or interaction issues.
[/list]

[/list]
[h3][b]Gameplay[/b][/h3]
[b]Abilities & Armaments:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fire Tornadoes do not apply fire affliction.
[*] Toxic Swarm ability does not display an AOE indicator.
[*] Armament VFX may disappear mid-session until the round ends.
[/list]
[b]Movement Issues:[/b]
[list]
[*] Sliding cancels when going off an edge.
[*] Sprint cancels after vaulting.
[*] Sprint acceleration may feel slower near objects when using the Kodiak Exo.
[*] Camera jitter may occur when vaulting.
[*] Rarely, a player's body may disappear after death, making them impossible to revive.
[/list]
[b]Weapons & Combat:[/b]
[list]
[*] Semi-automatic weapons may have slight input lag.
[*] Camera shifts to the left when aiming the Model 890 upwards.
[/list]
[h3][b]World & Environment[/b][/h3]
[b]Visual & Collision Issues:[/b]
[list]
[*] Floating/clipping objects, misaligned terrain, and gaps in the world may be encountered.
[*] Trees may appear stretched in high winds.
[*] Storm shelters may have gaps where players can fall through.
[*] Some cliffs and rocks may lack collision.
[*] Some bullet materials do not match the object they hit.
[*] The camera may clip through walls and objects.
[/list]
[b]Extraction Issues:[/b]
[list]
[*] In rare cases, players may get downed when entering an extraction dropship.
[*] The dropship may sometimes appear as a static model with closed doors.
[*] Workaround: Walk through the doors to extract.
[*] The extraction timer may briefly show "255" before the dropship arrives.
[/list]
[h3][b]Missions & Activities[/b][/h3]
[b]Assignments & Events:[/b]
[list]
[*] Some mastery level objectives may not update in real-time and require a restart or extraction.
[*] Certain Assignments may direct players to misplaced or inaccessible chests. Redeploying may lead to a different chest.
[*] Yellow 'new' markers may still appear in the Home Menu after turning in all missions.
[*] Some Assignments lack clear unlocking requirements in the Activities tab.
[/list]
[b]Artifacts & Objectives:[/b]
[list]
[*] In rare cases, an Artifact may be missing after completing the Rebirth Convoy World Event.
[*] Repeatable Operations objectives may reset instantly after completion, which can be confusing.
[/list]
[h3][b]AI & Bots[/b][/h3]
[b]Bot Behavior Issues:[/b]
[list]
[*] Bots cannot loot containers.
[*] Bots may carry two of the same weapon.
[*] Bots may jitter when walking on uneven terrain.
[*] Humanoid NPCs may have unrealistic falling animations after being defeated.
[*] Some enemies may lose their target when repositioning.
[*] Disruption and Shock Mines may not properly apply afflictions to NPCs.
[*] Specific to tutorial map: Rare occurrence of players being shot by invisible NPCs during the tutorial - this is likely due to overlap with other existing instantiated events. No workaround available.
[/list]
[h3][b]Customization & UI[/b][/h3]
[b]Character Customization Issues:[/b]
[list]
[*] Some eyebrow styles are missing names.
[*] Certain hair colors and EXO skins are missing thumbnails.
[*] On Low/Medium settings, body paints may not appear on some faces, and faces may lack animations.
[*] 'Type 7' face has an eyelid issue in the Home Menu.
[/list]
[b]UI Issues:[/b]
[list]
[*] The Shield Armament UI icon may stay visible after it is destroyed.
[*] Some EXO-Rig restrictions may not display correctly due to text overrun.
[*] Some UI elements, like player markers on the compass, may be missing.
[*] UI scaling issues may occur on ultra-wide screens.
[/list]

If you come across an issue while playing, please send us a report in [url=https://discord.com/channels/1140974664148066507/1334522221971902464]our Discord server here[/url]. You may also submit bug reports in-game.
 
Don’t have a playtest key yet? You can still sign up for one, as well as participate in our key giveaways [url=https://x.com/exoborne]on our X[/url].

See you very soon in the apocalypse!
/Sharkmob

notes.title: Exoborne Preview – Exhilarating Three-Player Extraction Chaos
notes.content:
It has been the decade of the extraction shooter. The gaming landscape today is packed with a deep catalogue of titles in the genre, and with so much competition, projects must stand out to make an impact. That’s exactly where Sharkmob fits in with its latest endeavour, Exoborne. The game introduces a fictional dystopian United States after societal collapse, a corrupt corporation exacerbating a climate change disaster, and, most importantly, exhilarating, edge-of-your-seat gameplay that sets it apart from being just another extraction shooter.

Exoborne is set in a decimated fictional location in the southern U.S. called Colton County. In this capitalist society, a corporation called Rebirth pushed propaganda onto civilians, offering hope for a bright future—or simply any future in the face of impending climate disaster. But Project Rebirth was a lie. Instead of delivering salvation, Rebirth drove humanity further into despair, forcing people to merge with machine-laden implants... Read more

notes.title: The Exoborne’s Closed Playtest has ended.
notes.content:
Hello Reborn!

The second Closed Playtest has now officially ended. Thank you all for playing Exoborne, and providing us with your invaluable feedback on Discord and filling out our surveys – we’ll now be going through all your comments, and in the future, share with you the changes that’ll be implemented based on your feedback.

And now, we’d like to share some fun things for you from your Closed Playtest experience!


[b]Closed Playtest Recap in Numbers[/b]
Agnesville and Maynard have never seen this much action before, as we’ve had over 73898 matches played throughout the Closed Playtest. You and your fellow Reborn have been able to snatch over 79456 guns from other poor unsuspecting Reborn and bandits, as well as taking down 35082 players… It has been chaotic during the Closed Playtest to say the least!


[b]Your Feedback[/b]
We cannot stress enough how much your feedback matters to us – we’re committed to making Exoborne a more enjoyable game for you, a valued member of our community. The discussions have already started, and throughout the playtest all the feedback you’ve given us will allow us to take further steps to improve the game! In fact, some of these improvements are already underway. So a big thank you for all of the feedback that you have sent our way through Discord and surveys. We will get back to you in the future to share what improvements we have done to the game.


[b]Influencer videos[/b]
In case you got hooked on Exoborne and will miss playing it on a daily basis, don't worry. We have plenty of content available from our influencers that you can check out.

As a reminder, this Closed Playtest was under NDA. That means that no game-related information,  content, images, screenshots, videos, or impressions are to be shared with anyone outside of our internal channels. We appreciate your discretion, as it enables us to get feedback on the game as early as possible.

notes.title: Unveiling New Environment Concept Art
notes.content:
Hello Exoborne Community!

Congratulations on completing stage 4 of the RE_HACK ARG and gaining access to the weather satellite!

Three new concept arts have been unlocked, which showcase more details about the environment in the game.

We designed the first one to evoke the familiar feeling of walking down the street in a regular suburban neighbourhood but with the forces of nature having drastically altered parts of the environment.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44781297/414cb480057a2e0039ddc0b813a1458724fcd5e9.jpg[/img]

The second one showcases the US Southern-style architecture, which you will frequently find in Exoborne.

Here, you can see how both nature and humans are utilizing the ruins of the old world.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44781297/9d694ba4fc21a7f4adbd37e53938ec7c4e8b213c.jpg[/img]

The third picture captures the intensity of a combat situation as a storm is quickly approaching. In Exoborne, you will always have to weigh the risks versus the rewards. Getting too greedy can be fatal!

This image was developed using a technique called ‘photo bashing’, where we use our photo references or 3D assets, layer them, and then paint over them.

This is a fast and efficient method to create concept art, especially when dealing with numerous details and objects of varying dimensions and wanting to maintain a realistic style.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44781297/20500c47b37b8a3e8da862eff8c470d0038d140b.jpg[/img]

Until next time, see you in the apocalypse!
/Sharkmob

notes.title: Making-of the Announcement Trailer Part 1
notes.content:
Hello Exoborne community!

Great work in solving the first challenge in our RE_HACK ARG, which unlocked the first part of our Exoborne announcement trailer’s behind-the-scenes series.

[previewyoutube=YS6mqXrCf7g;full][/previewyoutube]

For the announcement trailer, we got together with our good friends at Platige to create a trailer that sets the tone for what you can expect from Exoborne.

One of the things that was important for us was to capture the extreme force of nature unleashed by a tornado and the motion that would occur if someone would get sucked up by it.

Easier said than done, but we are always up for a good challenge!

Platige’s motion capture facility has a stage that is 20x13 meters with a height of 8(!) meters.

It is equipped with specialized cameras for pinpointing precision capture of body, face, and finger movement.

With such a large stage, we could capture the high-flying movement that was required for the announcement trailer.

As work continues on Exoborne, we are also utilizing motion capture technology for the game itself, and to ensure that it’s the absolute best it can be, we have built our very own state-of-the-art motion capture facility.

At a secondary location in Malmö, Sweden, we are housing a 21x9 meter mocap stage, which enables us to do all the advanced movements expected from a game like Exoborne.

This stage is equipped with specialized cameras used to capture the body movement of our motion capture actors in extreme fidelity, capturing even the slightest nuances of movement.

We also use wireless head cam systems to capture detailed facial animations.

Additionally, we also have an Xsens suit, which works as a portable motion capture suit, letting us capture movement outside of the studio.

This is perfect for capturing motion in environments that would be difficult to replicate in the studio.

We will be sharing a lot more details about the process around capturing motion for Exoborne in the future, so please stay tuned for that!
 
Until next time, see you in the apocalypse!

notes.title: Exoborne learns from devs' ill-fated battle royale game Bloodhunt
notes.content:
Before the futuristic, war-torn world of Exoborne, there was Bloodhunt, a Vampire: The Masquerade-inspired battle royale game that, for me, remains an all-time favorite. As Sharkmob's first entry to the online multiplayer fray, Bloodhunt struggled to gain momentum - largely a result of issues with cheating and balancing. With content development for the game officially dying the final death, Exoborne marks a new era for Sharkmob, and the team has used their Bloodhunt learnings to make the upcoming extraction shooter even better.

notes.title: Welcome to the world of Exoborne
notes.content:
Exoborne is a tactical open world extraction shooter that we have been secretly working on for quite some time now and we are absolutely thrilled that we finally had the opportunity to show it to you at The Game Awards 2023. 

In Exoborne, you will take on the role of a Reborn, an extraordinary survivor fitted with implants enabling you to use powerful Exo-Rigs. Equipped with this technology, you will fight to survive and thrive in a world plagued by warring factions, deadly elemental chaos, and other hostile Reborn. You will explore a part of the southeastern US, being torn apart by extreme forces of nature. Ever-changing threats by the world itself, and risky missions let you write your own stories each time you enter the world of Exoborne – like having an epic gunfight in a tornado.  

Exoborne is the ultimate apocalyptic power fantasy! 

Here are some key features that you can expect in Exoborne: 
 
•	[b]Forces of Nature[/b] will make you fight through deadly elemental chaos and adapt to the world’s constantly changing conditions. 
 
•	[b]Exo-Rigs[/b] unlock powerful abilities, not only enhancing vertical movement but also the raw powers of nature to your advantage when chosen wisely. 
 
•	[b]Verticality[/b] is key in a world turned upside down by the extreme forces of nature allowing for all new exploration and combat experiences. 
 
•	[b]Public events and missions[/b] raise the stakes and opportunities, allowing you to choose your own challenge. 
 
•	[b]Crafting and Customising[/b] enables you to take your own path within the game by exploring the world with new gear and equipment of your choosing. 
  
•	[b]Extraction gameplay[/b] gives you the opportunity to risk it all for greater rewards or play it safe – in the end the choice is up to you! 
 
•	[b]Thrilling storyline[/b] holds many secrets for you to uncover and evolves as you progress through the game.  
 
We will be excited if you join us on the journey of unleashing Exoborne into the world!  

You can do so by joining the Exoborne community over at discord.gg/exoborne where you can engage with other players and even our developers. 

And of course, make sure to follow and keep an eye on our social media for announcements, news, and other highlights! 
 
Lastly, in case you missed it, here is the Exoborne announcement trailer once more. 

[previewyoutube=esvQEDlavLs;full][/previewyoutube]

Until next time, see you in the apocalypse!
